title: ECoG_Tonal_Speech_Perception
description: This dataset contains electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from patients at Huashan Hospital during a speech perception task in a tonal language (Mandarin). The BIDS version provides the high-gamma envelope (70-150 Hz Hilbert transform) rather than raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF. It supports fine-grained spatiotemporal analysis of neural responses to tonal speech.
methods_description: Intracranial ECoG was recorded from participants during a speech perception task, with written informed consent given the day before surgery. The authors' 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope was derived from the source NWB iEEG series and exported to EDF in microvolts. Round-trip conversion error is reported per file.
